source.quote: This is a white item that actually kind of matches the canvas set pretty cleanly. And you never know when the most random of cloaks will just perfectly fit a transmog set. Now, there are a few other grays that don't have unique appearances, but a few of them are kind of cool and worth noting, like the fisherman's knife. Now, this might end up being part of our informal transmog set here on Goldilock. All in all, a massive W of a farm. And our auction shelves are filling up slow and steady. And even just a few of these selling anywhere close to market value, that's going to make a serious dent in our token progress. And that fisherman's knife, it's getting me itching for some more fishing content. So, I send Goldie on a new mission to hunt down the weatherbeaten journal from the sealed chests that spawn here in the Red Ridge waters. Now, we already did a deep dive on these chests in the last episode, so I won't go too far into it, but here's a quick recap. The Weatherbeaten journal has about an 8% drop rate from the chests, which can be fished up from the schools and the fishing pools here in Redidge. And if we can pull this journal, it's soulbound, but it grants a super useful perk. It lets you see fishing schools on the mini map, which is huge for any future fish farms that we might want to run. source.file: 008 - We Finally Got a World Drop Blue… Is It Enough To Escape？ - Goldbound Episode 8.en-orig.vtt
source.cleaned_file: goldbound/008 - We Finally Got a World Drop Blue… Is It Enough To Escape？ - Goldbound Episode 8.en-orig.txt
source.quote: Turns out this patch has some real consequences for us here in Redidge, and it's a bit of a mixed bag. So, let's start with the bad news. Do you remember that little discovery that made our mining grounds way more efficient? The one where we could mine ore while mounted? Well, it's gone, completely patched. So now when we're trying to gather while flying, we get the doomed you are flying notification and no mining is allowed. We have to dismount, mine, and remount every single time. And that slows down our max efficiency or routes by a decent margin. And I couldn't find anything in the official patch notes about this. So it was either a stealth fix or they just considered it a long sounding bug. But either way, it's definitely gone. Okay, now let's shift to something a little more ambiguous but positive. the openw world loot bugs. For a while now, it's been pretty well known that something weird's been going on with open world drops, especially with greens, transmog, drop tables, and world drops. But today, while running around post patch, something big happened. We got our first world blue drop of the entire series.

source.quote: A lot of people in the comments have been asking if I'm going to do a skinning farm here in Redidge. So, let's check it out. Unlike Elwin, the beasts in Redidge are fewer and farther between. A good chunk of them can't even be skinned. We're talking about the condors and the spiders. for these guys. You kill them, but you can't skin them. However, we do have great gore tusks. These guys are really spread out. There isn't a single spot with a solid hyperspawn. So, while we still have skinning trained, we can take a few of them as we move through the zone. But there's nothing here worth planting ourselves down for hours and just farming. On the plus side, they do drop the old rough leather scraps and light leather, but now it does give us access to light hide. So, we do have new materials if we eventually pick up a crafting recipe that use them. Then, in Red Ridge, there are Red Ridge foxes, a bit like the boores, but even more scarce and more scattered through the zone. Still, they do offer access to medium hide, which is a nice upgrade and another future reagent unlocked. And tucked away in the northeast corner of the zone, we do have forest stalkers.

source.quote: However, as luck would have it, we did pick up a new recipe from one of our red ridge drops, a tailoring recipe. And based on the tool tip, it looks like we might be able to craft using items we've already farmed in the zone. So, here's the plan. Let's head back to Elwin, unlearn skinning, and pick up tailoring. Luckily, we've been stockpiling cloth in the bank for just this kind of occasion. It doesn't sell for much raw, so we've been holding on to it for something more valuable or until we need to restock the shelves with shirts and linen cloth. And the recipe in question is the heavy woolen cloak. And we'll need 100 tailoring to make it. And while we level up, we may as well recraft and restock any shirts and any cloth transmogs that have recently sold out. For this, we're just using TSM to check which ones we're out of and what's profitable and just batch it all as we climb. But really, it's kind of just two or three of each one all the way up.
